_comment: Test-only Ed25519 key generated for the admin-auth contract test suite (cases.json), used only to produce a token signed by a key OTHER than the one published in the JWKS (the 'bad-signature-401' case, token.signWith == 'wrong-key'). This key is never published in a JWKS document and never signs anything real.
seedEncoding: hex, 32 bytes, the Ed25519 private key seed (RFC 8032).
